content.user_title: Adapt AI Responses with Behavioral Modes
content.value_statement: General-purpose assistants can use the wrong approach for a task. This skill selects structured modes for ideation, implementation, debugging, review, teaching, release, and collaboration.
actual_capabilities: Selects a mode from task signals such as build, debug, review, explain, or deploy.
Defines focused behavior and output formats for six primary operating modes.
Supports explicit mode selection through short slash-prefixed requests.
Provides an explore, plan, execute, and critique pattern for complex work.
Structures release checks across code quality, security, and performance.
limitations: Mode selection depends on clear task wording and may require user clarification.
The skill provides behavior guidance but does not supply domain-specific implementation knowledge.
Release checklists do not replace project tests, deployment controls, or expert review.
Referenced skills and artifacts may not exist in every assistant environment.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Feature
use_cases.description: Compare several approaches before choosing architecture or implementation details.

use_cases.title: Resolve a Software Defect
use_cases.description: Organize symptoms, root cause analysis, fixes, and prevention steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Production Release
use_cases.description: Review stability, security, quality, and performance before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Mode
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the best behavioral mode for this task: [task]. State the mode and begin with its expected structure.

prompt_templates.title: Brainstorm Alternatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Use BRAINSTORM mode for [goal]. Present at least three options with benefits, drawbacks, and one decision question.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Reproducible Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Use DEBUG mode. Analyze this symptom: [symptom]. Reproduction steps: [steps]. Evidence: [logs]. Identify the root cause, fix, and prevention.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Complex Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Use EXPLORE and PLAN-EXECUTE-CRITIC modes for [project]. Map dependencies, define atomic tasks, implement each task, then review security and performance.

output_examples.input: Brainstorm ways to reduce support response time.
output: Option A: Improve request routing. Benefit: faster assignment. Drawback: requires reliable categories.
Option B: Create response templates. Benefit: consistent answers. Drawback: templates need maintenance.
Option C: Add self-service guidance. Benefit: fewer tickets. Drawback: content must stay current.

output_examples.input: Review this authentication change before release.
output_examples.output: Critical: Verify token validation and secret handling. Improvements: Add failure tests and audit logging. Ready conditions: Tests pass and no secrets are exposed.

output_examples.input: Explain dependency injection to a new developer.
output_examples.output: Definition: Dependencies are provided to a component instead of created internally. This improves substitution, testing, and separation of responsibilities.

best_practices: Provide the task goal, constraints, and expected outcome before selecting a mode.
Use one primary mode and add another only when the workflow clearly changes.
Validate generated work with project-specific tests, policies, and human review.
anti_patterns: Do not force implementation mode when requirements or constraints remain unclear.
Do not treat a formatted checklist as proof that validation was completed.
Do not combine many modes without defining their order and responsibilities.

faq.question: Which assistants support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does the skill select modes automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps common task signals to modes, while allowing explicit mode requests.

faq.question: Can I switch modes manually?
faq.answer: Yes. Request brainstorm, implement, debug, or review mode directly in your prompt.

faq.question: Does this skill execute commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides behavioral guidance and example output structures.

faq.question: Can it coordinate complex tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes exploration and plan-execute-critic patterns for staged collaboration.

faq.question: Does ship mode guarantee a safe release?
faq.answer: No. Teams must still run project tests, security controls, deployment checks, and expert review.
